layout_dets.text: KATSUHISA SUGIMOTO AND YOSHINOBU SAWADA

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: Abstract

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: In the passive region of austenitic stainless steels alloyed with Mo, the formation of

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: ions can

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: be expected in neutral halide solutions by the transpassive dissolution of Mo. It has been shown that

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: ions added to neutral NaCl solutions act as an effective inhibitor against pitting of austenitic

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: stainless steels with and without Mo. The interaction between alloyed Mo in the steels and added

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: ions in the solutions is appreciable. It is likely that the inhibition of pit growth by the

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: adsorption of

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: ions which are thought to result from the dissolution of the steels at the initia!

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: stage of pitting leads to increased pitting resistance of austenitic stainless steels containing Mo.

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: It is a well known fact that the addition of Mo to austenitic stainless

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: steels increases pitting resistance because of shifts of the pitting

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: potential in the noble direction.1-6 Laboratory experiments, how-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: ever, show that the factors which lead to the increase in the pitting

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: resistance of the steel by alloying Mo are very complex. For

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: instance, the beneficial effect of Mo addition decreases with increase

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: in temperature,7 and the critical temperature at which pitting

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: initiates depends on the Mo content of the steel and the Ci

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: concentration of the solution used.8 It has been reported that

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: alloyed Mo is ineffective to inhibit bromide pitting.

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: more, published data indicating some differences between the

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: effects of Mo additions on austenitic stainless steel and ferritic

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: stainless steel have been presented.11

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: 4,9,10 Further-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: Although the action of Mo in regard to improving the resistance

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: of austenitic stainless steels against pitting is not known precisely,

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: we have proposed the following 2 mechanisms to account for the

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: inhibition: (1) the inhibition of pit initiation by an improvement of

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: the properties of the passive film for protection against invasion of

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: ions, and (2) the inhibition of pit growth by the adsorption of

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: ions, which are thought to be concentrated within a pit, by

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: the dissolution of the alloyed Mo at the initial stage of pitting.

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: Our recent X-ray photoelectron spectroscopy (ESCA) studies

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: on the passive film compositions of austenitic stainless steels

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: containing Mo have shown that Mo is one of the essential

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: constituents of the passive film, and that the Mo content of the film

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: increases with increase in Mo content of the steels.1² Therefore, it

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: would be reasonable to expect that the contribution of Mo in the

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: passive film is the cause of the improved pitting resistance of steel.

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: It is uncertain, however, whether the increase in pitting resistance is

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: brought about only by modifications of the properties ofthe passive

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: film, because the alloyed Mo may dissolve as

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: ions by the

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: transpassive reaction of Mo in the passive region of the steel.

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: Furthermore, it is difficult to explain by the film theory why the

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: alloying addition of Mo is ineffective in a NaBr solution.

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: Although knowledge of the contribution of

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: ions to the

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: mechanism of pitting inhibition for the Mo-containing austenitic

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: stainless steel is insufficient, it has previously been reported that

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: ions added to a neutral NaCl solution effectively inhibit the

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: pitting dissolution of an austenitic stainless steel that does not

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: contain Mo.1 Suzuki, et al, suggested the possibility of a higher

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: concentration of

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: ions in an active pit than in the bulk

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: solution for Type 316L and an 18Cr-16Ni-5Mo steel.'4

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: The purpose of the present study is to clarify the common

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: feature in both methods for pitting inhibition, that is, the alloying

layout_dets.text: Summary

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: It was found that

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: ions added to a neutral NaCl solution

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: acts effectively as a pitting inhibitor for the 20Cr-25Ni steel without

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: Mo. Both pit initiation and growth are suppressed by small additions

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: of

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: ions. Several similar effects are observed in both

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: methods for pitting inhibition, that is, alloying Mo in steels and

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: adding

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: ions to chloride solutions. Moreover, the multiplied

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: effect in the inhibition of pitting between Mo in the steel and

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: ions in the solution is recognized.

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: From results of the surface analysis by X-ray photoelectron

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: spectroscopy (ESCA), it is found that Mo(VI) ions in the passive

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: film participate in the inhibition of the chloride pitting of austenitic

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: stainless steel by alloyed Mo or added

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: ions, or both.

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: On the basis of these facts, it is reasonable to assume that the

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: resistance against pitting of Mo-containing austenitic stainless steels

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: in neutral halide solutions results from the inhibition of pit growth

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: by the adsorption of

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: ions which is concentrated in pits at

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: the initial stage of pitting.
